name: Sristy
headline: I build games, shaders and medical imaging software. Staff Engineer at SRBD in Dhaka, eleven years in.
intro: From casual games played inside telecom apps across Myanmar and Thailand to the DICOM module of an ultrasound imaging project, the thread is the same: pixels on a GPU that have to look right and run fast.
